newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler -got 700 mln dmk deferred tax boost.
newsitem.headline: Daimler -got 700 mln dmk deferred tax boost.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG chief financial officer Manfried Gentz said on Wednesday that deferred tax benefits from losses the company suffered in 1995 boosted net income by 700 million marks in 1996.
"The deferred taxes that have to be included in the financial statement in accordance with American accounting principles had a noticeable impact on net income," Gentz said in the text of a speech.
He said Daimler paid some 900 million marks of taxes on profits in 1996 but received a gain of 700 million marks related to losses in 1995.
Gentz said that due to the high volume of deferred taxes, operating profit rather than net income was a better measure of the company's performance.
